description: The active news sources BCA ingests (RSS feeds, X accounts, Reddit) with type, URL and trust tier, by tier, plus whether BCA collects each one now (collecting, not_collecting_reason) and when it last stored an item from it (last_fetched_at). X accounts stay listed but answer collecting false (x_reader_off) while the X reader is off. Returns the whole registry by default (162 sources on 2026-11-01); has_more and next_offset say when to page.

limit.description: Max sources (1 to 500; default 500, the whole registry).

type.description: Optional type filter, comma-separated: rss, twitter, reddit.

name: list_sources
